edges.reason: The constructor stores msg.sender as ownerAddress, granting privileged authority based on untrusted input.
The onlyBridge modifier on mint gates execution using msg.sender compared with bridgeContractAddress.
The onlyBridge modifier on burn gates execution using msg.sender compared with bridgeContractAddress.
The onlyOwner modifier on updateBridgeContractAddress authorizes via msg.sender.
The onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership authorizes via msg.sender.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debit sender passed to _transfer.
approve uses msg.sender as the owner argument passed to _approve.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is reduced.
Constructor assigns the _name argument to the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the _symbol argument to the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the constant 4 to the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes msg.sender into ownerAddress.
Constructor writes the _bridgeContractAddress argument into bridgeContractAddress.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping to return the account balance.
transfer delegates the balance mutation to the internal _transfer routine.
allowance reads the nested allowances mapping for owner and spender.
approve delegates the allowance write to the internal _approve routine.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move the tokens.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease the caller allowance via SafeMath.sub.
_transfer performs the balance arithmetic followed by the balances state writes.
The transfer operation updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
mint executes supply and balance increments after the onlyBridge check.
The mint operation increases totalSupply via SafeMath.add.
The mint operation credits the balances mapping of the target account.
burn executes balance and supply decrements after the onlyBridge check.
The burn operation decreases totalSupply via SafeMath.sub.
The burn operation debits the balances mapping of the target account.
_approve writes the amount into the nested allowances mapping.
updateBridgeContractAddress performs the privileged bridge address write after the onlyOwner check.
The bridge update operation replaces bridgeContractAddress, the address controlling mint and burn.
transferOwnership performs the privileged owner address write after the onlyOwner check.
The ownership operation replaces ownerAddress, the address controlling all onlyOwner functions.
